2374-7084-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Maja triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-5256-8175.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Edgar and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Edgar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, milling the targeted player a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

1251-1661-5078-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

147-4454-5147.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-4454-5147.description:
Cast Bond of Revival by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Bond of Revival.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Bond of Revival
Resolve the Bond of Revival copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

339-677-728-7297.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2921-6972-7936.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature other than Dominion Saboteur that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2921-6972-7936.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Dominion Saboteur.
When Dominion Saboteur dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it. As it enters, choose to have it copy a creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it, so Dominion Saboteur will also enter with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

1512-3525-5268.description:
Activate Stonybrook Schoolmaster by tapping it, adding {U}.
Stonybrook Schoolmaster triggers, creating a creature token
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Stonybrook Schoolmaster.
Repeat.

1409-5418-7824.description:
Activate Exhibition Magician by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Exhibition Magician enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Exhibition Magician.
Resolve the Exhibition Magician trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

215-1376-1879.notablePrerequisites: There are at least four Elves on the battlefield.
215-1376-1879.description:
Activate Priest of Titania by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Priest of Titania from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Priest of Titania by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2452-3249-5173-6797.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Shambling Ghast card from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Rooftop Storm.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2744-2921--5.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat

1183-2744-7426.description:
Activate Pentavus  by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Berta triggers, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3180-5660-7388.description:
Cast Chamber Sentry by paying {0}.
Chamber Sentry enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Rocksteady triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Chamber Sentry from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

1618-2440-2862-7377.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Lord of the Nazgûl
1618-2440-2862-7377.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Festering March.
Festering March triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Lord of the Nazgûl triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Festering March.
Repeat.
1618-2440-2862-7377.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Lord of the Nazgûl. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 2 or greater.

1636-2034-5803-7238.description:
Cast Break Down the Door by paying its mana cost.
Kitsa's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Holding priority, activate Kitsa's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Break Down the Door.
Resolve the copy of Break Down the Door, causing you to put a card from your library onto the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature.
When the creature enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the face-down creature, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3

3678-6798-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
3678-6798-6879.description:
Play a land.
When the land enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending the land that entered.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the earthbended land.
Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending the land that entered.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.

147-2511-6814.description:
Cast Abnormal Endurance by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Abnormal Endurance, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Abnormal Endurance.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Bloodflow Connoisseur abilities from step 5.

2034-2173-2932-5220.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2034-2173-2932-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional nontoken creature with mana value 1 or less.
2034-2173-2932-5220.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature with mana value 1 or less.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Bontu's Monument triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

2292-3652-5220-6900.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Ornithopter
When Ornithopter dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Ornithopter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Ornithopter from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

2173-2921-5220-6537.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Tarpan.
When Tarpan dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tarpan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Tarpan trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Cast Tarpan from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Oracle of Mul Daya

280-5449-5478-5702.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
280-5449-5478-5702.description:
Play Golgari Rot Farm. When it enters untapped due to Spelunking, Golgari Rot Farm and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate Golgari Rot Farm by tapping it, adding {B}{G}.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Oracle of Mul Daya.
Because of the additional Oracle of Mul Daya token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

1750-2793-5261-5740-6798.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Assassin that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1750-2793-5261-5740-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus
When Ugin's Nexus is sacrificed, it is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Pull from Eternity without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Pull from Eternity, putting Ugin's Nexus from exile into your graveyard.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using an Assassin, triggering Layla Hassan, returning Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
Repeat.

2034-3372-4927-6006.manaNeeded: {1}{W} if Enduring Vitality is not a creature
2034-3372-4927-6006.description:
If Enduring Vitality is not a creature, activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Enduring Vitality to become a creature.
Activate Enduring Vitality by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Enduring Vitality, adding {C}{C}.
When Enduring Vitality dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as an enchantment.
Repeat.

1069-1232-4927-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-1232-4927-5499.description:
Activate Nemata's first ability by paying {2}{G}, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Saproling.
Activate the Saproling by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

1497-2595-3327-4613.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
1497-2595-3327-4613.description:
Activate Combine Guildmage's first ability by paying {1}{G} and tapping it.
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Combine Guildmage.
Activate Dargo using Wild Cantor's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat from step 2.

942-2511-2523.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Samwise the Stouthearted.
When Samwise the Stouthearted dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Samwise the Stouthearted that is a 2/2 Zombie.
When the Samwise the Stouthearted token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing the Ring to tempt you, with the Samwise the Stouthearted token becoming your Ring-bearer.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

465-955-3742-4251-4875.notablePrerequisites: Conspiracy on the battlefield with "Samurai" chosen.
465-955-3742-4251-4875.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

3693-4369-4613.notablePrerequisites: The Red Terror has a +1/+1 counter on it.
3693-4369-4613.description:
Activate The Red Terror using Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
The Red Terror triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

710-997-2730.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

971-2178-3143-3490.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature with one or more +1/+1 counters on it.
You control at least one other creature.
Pentad Prism has at least one charge counter on it.
Thornbite Staff attached to Xavier Sal.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
971-2178-3143-3490.description:
Activate Xavier Sal's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Xavier Sal triggers, untapping Xavier Sal.
Resolve the Xavier Sal ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control and a charge counter on Pentad Prism.
Animation Module triggers, holding priority, activate Pentad Prism by removing a charge counter from it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite +1/+1 counters among creatures you control, you may instead use Xavier Sal's first ability to get infinite copies of creature tokens you control.

2092-2516-4050.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 5 or greater.
2092-2516-4050.description:
Activate Thundering Spineback by paying {G} due to Agatha of the Vile Cauldron, creating a 3/3 Dinosaur creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Dinosaur, adding {G}.
Repeat.

751-765-3314-3470.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield.
Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Lotus Cobra.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {U}.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1765-3161-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Spirit.
1765-3161-5256.description:
Cast Reins of the Vinesteed by paying {3}{G}, attaching it to a Spirit.
Reins of the Vinesteed enters the battlefield, triggering Chishiro, creating a 2/2 Spirit token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature with Reins of the Vinesteed attached.
The creature dies, triggering Reins of the Vinesteed, returning Reins of the Vinesteed from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to a Spirit.
Reins of the Vinesteed enters the battlefield, triggering Chishiro, creating a 2/2 Spirit token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the Spirit's power.
Repeat from step 3.

1558-3129-3529-4231.notablePrerequisites: Hoard Robber does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by at least one opponent.
1558-3129-3529-4231.description:
Attack with Hoard Robber.
Hoard Robber triggers on combat damage to a player, creating two Treasure tokens, two Food tokens, and two Clue tokens.
Activate Time Sieve's ability by tapping Time Sieve and sacrificing five artifacts you control, taking an extra turn after this one.
Repeat.

1232-1912-4474-5153.notablePrerequisites:
Sunstrike Legionnaire does not have summoning sickness.
Paradise Mantle attached to Sunstrike Legionnaire.
1232-1912-4474-5153.description:
Tap Sunstrike Legionnaire to add {G}.
Pay {G} to create a 1/1 Saproling token.
Sunstrike Legionnaire triggers, untapping.
Repeat.

16-4944.description:
Activate Lavaclaw Reaches's ability so that it becomes a creature.
Activate it to give it +0/+0 until end of turn infinite times to get infinite Construct triggers.
Repeat.

687-1322-2034-2987.description:
Cast Channeler Initiate by paying {1}{G}.
Channeler Initiate enters the battlefield with a vigilance counter, putting three -1/-1 counters on itself.
Activate Channeler Initiate by tapping and removing a -1/-1 counter from it, adding one mana of any color.
Activate Tayam by paying {3} and removing all counters from Channeler Initiate.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Channeler Initiate, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Tayam ability, milling three cards and returning Channeler Initiate from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
